paper.title_en: Radiative-recoil corrections at order $α^2 (Z α)^5$ to energy levels of muonium and positronium
paper.abstract_en: We have calculated radiative-recoil corrections at order $α^2 (Z α)^5$ to the energy levels of spin-1/2--spin-1/2 Coulombic bound systems. The corrections we consider involve two exchange photons with two-loop radiative corrections on the electron line. We obtain precise results for all values of the mass ratio. Our results are relevant for upcoming improved measurements of the muonium ground-state hyperfine splitting and 1S-2S interval.
